summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are visiting an old-fashioned village that has a very dark past. While there, a man is nearly murdered, and by his body was what seemed to be a ghost. Is there a trick to this murder case, and could the murder have anything to do with the village's dark past? Also, who was the ghost? Based on Professor Agasa's research, a robbery happened near the village and the prime suspect is Eiji Nagakura. One month ago, Eiji Nagakura committed suicide due to being framed as a murderer.
